evolveitem.blackaugurite.description: A strange black stone that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.blackaugurite.letter.quest: Hey @!^I've been looking for something called Black Augurite. Apparently, the last place anyone saw it was somewhere around the Calico Desert.^If you happen to find one, could you bring it to me? I'd really like to get my hands on it. I've been wondering what it tastes like.^...I mean, what it's like.^Anyway, please hurry!^— Abigail
evolveitem.blackaugurite.letter.reward: Hey @!^Thanks again for the Black Augurite. You never guess what it did with my scyther! I hope you enjoy it aswell!^-- Abigail
evolveitem.blackaugurite.quest.descripti: Abigail is looking for a Black Augurite from the Calico Desert. Apparently, she has a very particular interest in this stone.
evolveitem.blackaugurite.quest.objective: Find a black augurite for Abigail
evolveitem.blackaugurite.quest.response: You found it! Thank you so much for bringing this to me. I won't forget that you went all the way to the Calico Desert to find it for me. I owe you one!
evolveitem.dragon.scale.description: A scale from a Dragon Pokémon that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.dragon.scale.letter.egg: Dear @,^Your discovery has raised more questions than it has answered.^I have spent some time studying the dragon scale, and there is indeed something unusual about it. More importantly, I believe the forest spirits left out a crucial part of their message.^They spoke of a creature hidden within an egg. Something... Something... Seahorse? Horsea?^Rasmodius
evolveitem.dragon.scale.letter.quest: Dear @,^The forest spirits have whispered to me of a peculiar object hidden upon a distant island.^They speak of a special dragon scale, found somewhere near the volcano on Ginger Island. According to them, this scale will 'turn a sea to a king.'^I have no idea what that means. Naturally, I would very much like to find out.^Rasmodius
evolveitem.dragon.scale.letter.reward: Dear @,^At last, the meaning of the spirits' message has become clear.^The dragon scale did not turn the sea into a king. Rather, it belonged to a creature that rules the seas themselves.^The egg you recovered has revealed its true nature. Within it lies a Pokémon of ancient power, one whose connection to the ocean is unmistakable.^Rasmodius
evolveitem.dragon.scale.quest.descriptio: The forest spirits have spoken of a strange dragon scale hidden near the volcano on Ginger Island. Their cryptic message promises that it will 'turn a sea to a king.' The Wizard wants to uncover the meaning behind it.
evolveitem.dragon.scale.quest.egg.descri: The Wizard believes the forest spirits' cryptic message referred to a Horsea egg.
evolveitem.dragon.scale.quest.egg.object: Find a Dragon Scale for the Wizard
evolveitem.dragon.scale.quest.egg.respon: Bring the Wizard a Horsea egg.
evolveitem.dragon.scale.quest.objective: Find a Dragon Scale for the Wizard
evolveitem.dragon.scale.quest.response: Fascinating... This is precisely the scale the spirits described. I can feel a peculiar energy lingering within it. Let us see what secrets it holds.
evolveitem.dubious.disc.description: A transparent device of dubious origin that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.dubious.disc.quest.objective: Find the Dubious Disc for Maru
evolveitem.electirizer.description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy.
evolveitem.electirizer.letter.egg: Hey @!^Okay, I just realized something kind of important.^I forgot that I need a Elekid egg for the trick, too.^Could you bring me one? I promise the trick will be worth it!^Sam
evolveitem.electirizer.letter.quest: Hey @!^So, funny story. I lost part of my electric guitar while skating through town. It's called an Electirizer, and yeah... I already bought a replacement.^But if you happen to find the old one, bring it to me! I know a neat trick to show you.^Later!^Sam
evolveitem.electirizer.letter.reward: Hey @!^You've officially got front-row seats for the coolest trick I've ever pulled off.^The Electirizer, the egg... put them together and you get something completely new.^I call it an Electirizer Egg! Pretty cool, right?^Thanks for helping me put all the pieces together. I couldn't have pulled it off without you.^Laters!^Sam
evolveitem.electirizer.quest.description: Sam lost an Electirizer from his electric guitar while skating through town. He's already replaced it, but says the old one could help him show off a cool trick.
evolveitem.electirizer.quest.egg.descrip: Sam has everything he needs for his trick... Except for the very import Elekid egg.
evolveitem.electirizer.quest.egg.respons: YES! That's exactly the one! Okay, now we're ready. You are seriously going to love this.
evolveitem.electirizer.quest.response: No way! You actually found it! Nice! Okay, give me a little time to set things up and I'll show you that trick I mentioned.
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.description: A cuff made from Galarica twigs that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.letter.quest: Dear @,^I seem to have misplaced something rather important during an outdoor lesson with the children in Cindersap Forest.^It is a Galarian Cuff, and I have a feeling it must have fallen somewhere along the path while I was helping the children. I've looked around myself, but I haven't been able to find it.^If you happen to come across it, would you please bring it back to me? I'd be very grateful.^Thank you,^Penny
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.letter.reward: Dear @,^Thank you again for finding my Galarian Cuff. I was worried I would never see it again.^I still have some of the Pokémon eggs left over from our lesson, and I thought you might like to have it. The children were very excited about it, so I hope it finds a good home with you.^There is one more thing, though. While putting everything away, I realized that my Galarian Wreath is missing too. I must have lost it somewhere in Cindersap Forest during the lesson.^Would you be willing to have another look for me?^Thank you,^Penny
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.quest.descripti: Penny lost her Galarian Cuff while teaching an outdoor lesson in Cindersap Forest. Help her find it.
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.quest.objective: Find the Galarica Cuff for Penny
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.quest.response: Oh! You found it! I was beginning to think it was gone for good. Thank you so much. I really appreciate your help.
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.description: A wreath made from Galarica twigs that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.letter.reward: Dear @,^I wanted to give you a little something for all your help.^Here is another Pokémon egg from the Galarian region. The children were very fascinated by it, so perhaps you'll have just as much fun discovering what hatches from this one.^I'm very glad my Galarian Wreath has found its way home again. It means a lot to me that you took the time to look for it.^Take care,^Penny
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.quest.descrip: Penny discovered that her Galarian Wreath is missing after putting away the supplies from her outdoor lesson. She thinks she may have lost it in Cindersap Forest.
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.quest.objecti: Find a Galarica Wreath for Penny
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.quest.respons: You found it! Thank you so much. I really should have been more careful with my things that day. I'm just glad it's back where it belongs.
evolveitem.kings.rock.description: A royal-looking stone that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.kings.rock.letter.quest: Dear @,^While taking a stroll along the beach, I noticed a most peculiar stone half-buried in the sand.^It had a unique shape, almost like a tiny crown carved from stone. There was something strangely captivating about it, and the image has remained in my mind ever since.^Unfortunately, when I returned to look for it, it was nowhere to be found. Perhaps the waves carried it away with the tide.^If you happen to spot this rock along the beach, would you bring it to me? I have a feeling it may provide just the inspiration I've been searching for.^Yours,^Elliott
evolveitem.kings.rock.letter.egg: Dear @,^The King's Rock has proven to be quite the source of inspiration. I've been staring at it for hours, imagining all sorts of stories surrounding its origin.^Yet I find myself wondering about something else.^For some reason, every time I try to develop the story further, my thoughts keep returning to {pokemon}. I can't quite explain it. I walk along the beach, I sit down to write, and somehow I end up thinking about them again.^Perhaps my mind is trying to tell me something. If you happen to come across a {pokemon} egg, would you bring it to me? It may be just the thing I need to finally understand where this story is going.^Yours,^Elliott
evolveitem.kings.rock.letter.reward: Dear @,^I'm afraid I must confess that I reached a rather unfortunate impasse.^I had the King's Rock, the egg, and all the inspiration in the world... and yet I found myself staring at a completely blank page.^A writer's block of the most dreadful kind. So, defeated, I decided to retire early and try again in the morning.^When I awoke, I discovered something extraordinary. The egg had somehow fused with the King's Rock. I don't know how such a thing is possible, but the result is absolutely magnificent. I've never seen anything quite like it. It's strange, unexpected, and completely inspiring.^I can't stop writing. I finally know where the story is going, and I have pages upon pages to fill.^This is my muse, and I have you to thank for it.^Yours,^Elliott
evolveitem.kings.rock.quest.description: Elliott spotted a peculiar King's Rock on the beach and has been unable to stop thinking about it. When he returned for it, the stone had disappeared.
Elliott can't seem to stop thinking about {pokemon} whenever he works on his story. He wonders if a {pokemon} egg might help him discover where his inspiration is leading him.
evolveitem.kings.rock.quest.objective: Find a King's Rock for Elliott
evolveitem.kings.rock.quest.response: There it is! The very stone I remember. How fortunate that it found its way back to shore. I can already feel the beginnings of an idea taking shape.
evolveitem.kings.rock.quest.response.egg: Yes... this feels right. I can't explain why, but I think this is exactly what my story has been waiting for.
evolveitem.magmarizer.description: A box packed with energy that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.magmarizer.letter.quest: Ahoy @!^There's something I ought to tell ye.^The other day, I was hearin' some stories over at the saloon about Magmar and these things called Magmarizers. Sounded like sailor's tales at first, but I found one myself while exploring Ginger Island.^Imagine that! A real Magmarizer, just sitting there waiting to be found.^Only yesterday, when ye brought me that Magby Egg, I went looking for the Magmarizer to see if the two had anything to do with each other. That's when I realized I'd lost the darn thing.^I reckon it must've fallen overboard while I was out on the boat. If ye've got the time, could ye take a look around and see if ye can find it?^Fair winds,^Willy
evolveitem.magmarizer.letter.egg: Ahoy @!^Could ye bring me a Magby Egg if ye happen to come across one?^I've got a little something I'd like to try with it. Nothing dangerous, mind ye. Just a bit of curiosity from an old fisherman.^Bring it to me when ye can, and I'll make sure ye get something useful in return.^Fair winds,^Willy
evolveitem.magmarizer.letter.reward: Ahoy, @!^I've made a discovery worth telling the whole saloon about!^That Magby Egg and the Magmarizer weren't just some strange curiosities. They led me to something I never knew existed.^A Magmartor! A magnificent creature, full of heat and fire. I reckon I've never seen anything quite like it in all my years on the water.^There's just one problem. I've learned that Magmartors aren't particularly fond of boats. Can't say I blame them. The sea's no place for a creature made of fire. I reckon ye can give this one a better life on land than an old fisherman ever could.^Still, what an adventure! Thanks for giving this old sailor something exciting to chase after.^Fair winds and good fishin',^Willy
evolveitem.magmarizer.quest.description: Willy found a Magmarizer on Ginger Island, but only realized it was missing after receiving the Magby Egg. He suspects it fell overboard from his boat.
evolveitem.magmarizer.quest.response: There she is! I was beginning to think the sea had claimed her for good. Now let's see what happens when we put the two together...
evolveitem.magmarizer.quest.egg.descript: Willy is looking for a Magby Egg for something he's planning. He promises a useful reward in return.
evolveitem.magmarizer.quest.egg.response: Well, I'll be! That's one fiery little egg.

stone.dawn.feeling: A gentle energy stirs within you.
stone.dusk.description: It seems to absorb the light around it, casting an oddly dark shadow.
stone.dusk.feeling: A strange stillness settles over you.
stone.event.gunther.intro: Oh, good morning ${Mr.^Ms.}$ @! I hope it's not too early... Well, I just wanted to stop by and thank you in person for lending me your evolution stone. I had a call with {professor} to identify the stone. It seems to be a {power} and can be used to evolve {pokemons}. Isn't that amazing?! Well, I should let you get back to your work...
stone.event.gunther.message: You got the '{stone}'! It's been added to your wallet. {feeling} You've got a deeper understanding of your Pokémon.
stone.event.gunther.return: Oh! I almost forgot! Here is your {power} back.
stone.fire.description: It radiates an unusual warmth, even when surrounded by cold.
stone.fire.feeling: A gentle warmth spreads through your body.

stone.ice.description: It radiates an unnatural cold, yet never seems to melt or frost over.
stone.ice.feeling: A sudden chill runs through your body.
stone.ice.pokemons: Alolan Sandshrew, Alolan Vulpix, Eevee, Galarian Duramaka, Crabrawler and Cetoddle.
stone.item.description: {{extra}} Maybe Gunther can tell you more.

stone.leaf.feeling: You feel a sense of vitality spreading through your body.
stone.leaf.pokemons: Gloom, Weepinbell, Exeggcute, Hisuian Voltorb, Eevee, Nuzleaf and Pansage.

stone.shiny.feeling: You feel a strange clarity come over you.
stone.specialorder.donate: Deliver the evolution stone in the drop box at the museum counter.
stone.specialorder.text: Recent reports suggest that an evolution stone may be hidden among the geodes. If you happen to uncover one, please bring it to me. I'd very much like to examine it.
stone.sun.description: It feels strangely warm and seems to hold a faint inner glow.
stone.sun.feeling: A warm energy fills your body.
stone.sun.pokemons: Gloom, Sunkern, Cottonee, Petilil and Helioptile.
stone.thunder.description: It emits an unusual electrical charge.
stone.thunder.feeling: You feel an electrical charge through your body.
stone.thunder.pokemons: Pikachu, Magneton, Eevee, Nosepass, Eelektric, Charjabug and Tadbulb.
stone.water.description: Its surface is strangely cool and damp, as though it has just been pulled from deep water.
stone.water.feeling: You feel a cool sensation wash over you.
stone.water.pokemons: Poliwhirl, Shellder, Staryu, Eevee, Lombre and Panpour.
